name: water_planter_hold
text: A person stands facing a low window flower planter. Hold a watering can by its upper handle in the right hand in front of the waist, tip its spout gently toward the soil, then restore it upright. Left hand hangs relaxed. Remain outside the planter and keep the can clear of the flowers and ledge.
